verdict.rationale: Kino AI is a desktop and cloud video-editing app, so a telemetry opt-out is a fair question for it. However, no evidence describes telemetry settings, usage-tracking controls, or any opt-out mechanism. "No account needed" is an adjacent privacy trait, not a telemetry opt-out, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
